title: ranunculus hirsutus var. parvulus
intro: Ranunculus hirsutus var. parvulus, commonly known as Mountain Buttercup, is a small, delicate plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Buttercup include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily alkaloids, including ranunculin and hirsutin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
